features.title: Instant playback of huge WAV / AIFF files
features.summary: PCM files stream straight off disk in small chunks, so a 2 GB multichannel take starts playing as fast as a one-second click.

features.title: Surround, immersive and ambisonic monitoring
features.summary: Every channel gets its own waveform lane with mute / solo, and multichannel files can be heard as stereo, binaural (HRTF) or on discrete outputs.

features.title: Drag a selection straight into your DAW
features.summary: Select part of a waveform and drag it out; a new WAV of just that part is written, keeping the channel layout and BWF / iXML metadata.

features.title: Automatic sound categories
features.summary: Sounds are sorted into categories from their names and metadata, and ones with unclear names are listened to in the background to sort them too.

features.title: Duplicate finder by audio or by name
features.summary: Finds files with identical audio even when renamed or re-tagged, or files that share a name, and can recycle the extra copies.

features.title: Projects that reference sounds without copying them
features.summary: Gather sounds into a project without moving anything, then zip it or copy it into a real folder when you need to hand it off.

features.title: Search free sound effects inside the app
features.summary: Searches Freesound, Wikimedia Commons and the Internet Archive for attribution-free (CC0 / public domain) sounds you can preview and save with one click, with credits logged in Credits.txt.

features.title: Website search across sound sites
features.summary: Type a search once and open it on Pixabay, Zapsplat, Sonniss and other sound sites, each labelled with its licence terms.

features.title: Epidemic Sound in the same search
features.summary: Search, preview and save Epidemic Sound effects as WAV through Epidemic's official service, using your own subscription.

features.title: Multi-select and recycle from the library
features.summary: Ctrl / Shift-click to select many sounds, then drag, add to a project or move them to the Recycle Bin together.

features.title: Add a whole category to a project
features.summary: Right-click a category to add every sound in it, or only the ones currently listed, to a project.

features.title: dB scale and loudness readout on the waveform
features.summary: An even -40 to 0 dBFS scale sits beside the waveform, with each channel's peak and RMS shown before you press play.

features.title: Online results appear as each site answers
features.summary: Search results show up from the fastest site first instead of waiting for the slowest, and a site that stalls times out with a clear message.

features.title: Fast previews of big Commons recordings
features.summary: Large Wikimedia Commons WAV / FLAC files are previewed through a small MP3 copy, while Save still downloads the original.

features.title: About window and What's new after each update
features.summary: Click the app name to see the version, build date and release notes; after an update, a short note shows what changed, once.

features.title: Size and free-space checks before big copies
features.summary: Materialize, zip, extract and downloads show their size first, stop if the drive is too full, ask twice for very large jobs and can be cancelled cleanly.

features.title: Project size at a glance
features.summary: Each project shows how much disk space it would take if materialized, before you start the copy.

features.title: Warning before deletes that can't be undone
features.summary: Recycling files on a network or USB drive, where Windows has no Recycle Bin, gets its own warning, and huge batches ask twice.

features.title: Zip extraction that never overwrites
features.summary: Extracting keeps files that are already there instead of overwriting them, checks free space, and warns about zips that unpack to far more than their own size.

features.title: Searchable Settings panel
features.summary: One section at a time with a plain description under every setting, a search box and per-section reset; every change applies at once and is remembered.

features.title: Copy a problem report
features.summary: Errors are logged quietly, and one click copies the version, system and recent errors to paste into a bug report.

features.title: Long MP3 / FLAC files use a fraction of the memory
features.summary: Long compressed files are decoded a piece at a time instead of all at once: a 52-minute MP3 takes about a third of the memory, with identical sound.

features.title: Library folders update by themselves
features.summary: Sounds added, renamed or deleted in a linked folder show up within seconds, without a restart or manual rescan.

features.title: Pick the output device
features.summary: Play previews through a chosen audio interface or speakers, separately from the Windows default; the choice is remembered.

features.title: Automatic cleanup of dragged selections
features.summary: Selection files made when dragging part of a waveform into a DAW can be moved to the Recycle Bin after 7, 30 or 90 days.

features.title: Tape-style varispeed while previewing
features.summary: A speed slider changes speed and pitch together, up to an octave either way, without touching the file or what you drag out.

features.title: Matched loudness preview
features.summary: MATCH plays every sound at the same perceived loudness while auditioning, so quiet and loud files compare fairly.

features.title: Loudness and true peak for every sound
features.summary: The info panel shows integrated loudness (LUFS) and true peak, measured as the waveform loads or in the background.

features.title: Spectrogram view
features.summary: Switch the waveform to a spectrogram that sharpens as you zoom; its level range, scale and colours are adjustable and remembered.

features.title: Star ratings for sounds
features.summary: Rate sounds 1 to 5 stars with Ctrl+1…5 or a click, see them in a Rating column, and filter to 4 stars and up.

features.title: Your own notes on sounds
features.summary: Write notes on any sound; they are searchable and never written into the audio file.

features.title: Named markers on recordings
features.summary: Drop named markers on long recordings with K and jump back to them; exports can include a markers list.

features.title: Recently played list
features.summary: The sidebar lists the last sounds you auditioned, newest first.

features.title: Search with synonyms and typo tolerance
features.summary: Searching gun also finds rifle and pistol, small typos still find the sound, and rating:4+ or has:notes search your own fields.

features.title: Find similar sounds
features.summary: List the library sounds closest to the one you are on, by measured sound features, category, name and length.

features.title: Hide folders from All sounds
features.summary: Click the eye beside a library folder to keep its sounds out of All sounds and search while still browsing it directly.

features.title: Undo for everyday changes
features.summary: Removing sounds from a project, deleting a project, clearing ratings or notes and hiding folders can be undone.

features.title: Sharper spectrograms
features.summary: Short sounds and zoomed-in views get a spectrogram column per screen pixel, with smooth low frequencies.
